Tankless Water Heater Installation and Repairs

Many older homes have a hot water tank in the attic. This insulated tank holds water which is usually heated via an immersion heater. If you have this kind of heating system, you’ll need to plan your water usage, as it takes time for the water in the tank to heat up. If you have a large family and several people want to bathe or shower in quick succession, you may find that the tank isn’t large enough to meet your hot water needs.

Tankless heaters don’t have these issues, as the water is heated as it passes through the system. All you need to do is turn the tap, and you’ll have hot water flowing. Many families find this type of system saves them money on their energy bills, as they’re no longer doing the equivalent of heating a full tank of water every day. They only heat the water that they actually want to use.

items: Get instant hot water, whenever you need it
Never worry about running out of hot water again
Heat only the water you use, potentially saving energy
No more worrying about a leaking hot water tank
